t-introhistory: MedicFollow, having been elected the best EIP project at Epitech Marseille, has been chosen to be presented to "L'Accelerateur M", an association specializing in helping and supporting young companies in the territory.
t-firstplatform: The first platform that facilitates communication around the patient
t-goalMF: Optimize and speed up communication between the medical profession in charge of the patient and the family thanks to MedicFollow.
t-helpedwith: Using a suite of tools suitable for individuals and medical professionals.
t-finddoc: Find all your loved one's documents in a single, secure space.
t-stayuptodate: Stay informed of your loved one's upcoming appointments, wherever you are.
t-anychange: Any change in your loved one's situation will be notified to you.

t-justreload: A simple restart will allow you to benefit from our updates, you will be notified when new features arrive.
t-justinternet: A browser and an internet connection will suffice for you to benefit from the services of MedicFollow.
t-whatfaqtext: The FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions), also called “Frequently Asked Questions”, is a list of answers to the most frequently asked questions.
t-whatmftext: Medicfollow is a platform under development, which will be available on mobile and web in order to facilitate communication between medical staff and patients' families.
t-wheremftext: Medicfollow will be available in France only for now, soon in Europe.
t-costmftext: Medicfollow is free to use for individuals, for healthcare professionals and medical organizations there will be a monthly subscription.
t-langmftext: Medicfollow's mobile and web clients support the following languages: French, English, Spanish, German and Italian.
t-probmftext: To solve your problem, contact us in the form above and provide as much information as possible.
t-secucentertext: Your safety on MedicFollow is important to us, which is why we've created the Safety Center, where you'll find helpful resources, tools and tips on a variety of topics.
t-yourdatatext: You can manage and view your privacy settings and controls from the "Your Data in MedicFollow" page, which includes a summary of your content and activity data, settings for managing that data, and usage information that is made to improve MedicFollow.
t-deleteacctext: The deletion of a professional MedicFollow account is available after contacting our support, for private accounts, the deletion is automatic after 6 months of inactivity or after the request in the user settings.
t-installtext: MedicFollow is available for installation on the PlayStore and AppleStore, uninstallation runs in your phone settings.
t-howcontacttext: The telephone number indicated at the top of this page will allow you to contact customer service, if the latter is not reachable, you can always contact us via the form above.
t-notansweredtext: In this case, simply contact us via the contact form, our advisers will answer your questions as soon as possible.
t-simplecost: Simplified pricing and no hidden fees.
t-justforyou: Advanced features for your medical organization.

t-mars2021bis: Creation of the "Web" platform for individuals

t-oct2021text: The secondary asset to bring convenience to our users' daily lives: implementation of the calendar service and smart reminders.
t-oct2021: Added "Agenda" functionality to both MedicFollow platforms

t-sept2020text: The MedicFollow project was founded during the MoonShot 2020 Pool at Epitech Marseille.
t-oct2020text: MedicFollow, having been elected the best EIP project at Epitech Marseille, has been chosen to be presented to "L'Accélérateur M", an association specializing in helping and supporting young companies in the area.
t-dec2020text: The first "BRAINSTORMING" sprint allowed MedicFollow to develop new ambitions and new goals for the future of development.
t-jan2021text: Collection of opinions from medical professionals concerning the need for a tool to facilitate communication between relatives and the staff caring for the patient(s).
t-mars2021text: The first step in the development of the Closed Beta was the creation of the "web" platform, accessible to individuals from any internet browser.
t-avri2021text: After the "web" platform, our second objective was to offer MedicFollow's solutions for individuals on "Mobile" as well, the background services for the correct execution of the MedicFollow functionalities started to be developed.
t-juil2021text: The main objective being to save time for our medical staff, our "web" platform has received a content update to allow professionals to use our services more easily than individuals.
t-sept2021text: The main asset to facilitate communication between medical staff and relatives: setting up the chat service.
t-dec2021text: After new feedback from medical staff following our first MedicFollow beta tests, we continue to improve our features.
t-mai2022text: Our constant improvements in terms of security and wealth of features allow us now to provide a suite of software suitable for the public for testing purposes.
t-q22022text: The MedicFollow solution is starting to take shape, we have recruited beta testers to collect first impressions and validate our user journey.
t-q32022text: The feedback from our beta testers has allowed us to identify areas for improvement, we are working to improve the solution by listening to our testers.
t-jan2023text: Presentation of the project at the "Epitech Experience" in front of a jury of professionals and students.
